description: This file defines culture-specific information for Arabic (Libya) date and time formatting, including day/month names, date patterns, regex patterns for parsing, and various date manipulation functions following the DateJS library conventions.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets time components (hours, minutes, seconds, milliseconds) to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date object to the current local time.
